$comment: AI workbench data. Two kinds of content live here and they are kept strictly apart. `workflow` is a description of how Ammar works — it is editorial and always safe to render. `measured` is numbers, and it is only ever written by `npm run sync:ai`, which counts local Claude Code session transcripts on this machine. Nothing here is estimated, projected or rounded up. If `measured.measuredAt` is null the whole metrics strip is omitted from the README rather than rendered empty.

workflow.$comment: Where a model actually sits in the loop. `owner` is who has the last word on that stage: `human` means a model does not get to decide it.

tools.$comment: Tools in actual use. Not a list of everything that exists.

measured.$comment: Written by `npm run sync:ai`. Do not hand-edit — if a number here was typed rather than counted, the section has failed its only job. Run the sync locally and commit the result; CI never has access to these files and must not try.
measured.scope: One workstation. Reflects retained local history only, not account totals.
